page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head at top; page number at top left. No marginal notes visible apart from faint show-through.

main_text.p: Miserere mei regina gloriæ & honoris, & ab omni periculo custodi mentem meam.
main_text.head: LXXVIII.
main_text.p: Psalmo LXXVIII. Domina, venerunt gentes in hæreditatem Dei, quas tu mericis tuis Christo confœderasti.
main_text.head: LXXIX.
main_text.p: Psalmo LXXIX. Qui regis Israël, intende ad me, fac me dignè matrem tuam collaudare. Charismatum suorum fragrantia suavianimæ mortuæ suscitantur.
main_text.head: LXXX.
main_text.p: Psalmo LXXX. Exultate Dominæ adjutrici nostræ. Currite ad illam devotione (sancta), & de bonis suis participabit vobis.
main_text.head: LXXXI.
main_text.p: Psalmo LXXXI. Terge fœditatem meam, Domina, quæ semper rutilas puritate. Fons vitæ influe in os meum, ex quo viventes aquæ profluunt. Omnes sitientes venite ad illam. Qui hauriet ex ea, saliet in vitam æternam, & qui bibit ex ea, non sitiet unquam.
main_text.head: LXXXII.
main_text.p: Psalmo LXXXII. Domina mea, quis similis tibi? quia gratia & gloria supereminet universa. Fac me desiderare honorificare

page.notes: Words in the printed text are partly obscured by damage and show-through; the last line reads "norifi-" (catchword-like hyphenated fragment, possibly "honorifi-"). Parenthetical bracketing in the LXXX paragraph is a transcription aid, as "sancta" is printed "sancta" with uncertain letters.
